meta.title: Order Activity is offered on a live RFQ where Vendor An and Vendor B have bid
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with two bids on its summary page.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Assert that the RFQ Settings menu offers Order Activity and that it is clickable.
Select Order Activity from the RFQ Settings menu to open its activity window.
Assert that the Order Activity window opened.
Assert that the activity window contains the expected event activity entry.
Cancel the Order Activity window without changing anything.
Assert that the activity window closed after cancellation.
